hero.titleHighlight: your space — power, Wi-Fi, and a seat, in one click.
hero.lead: Masahati brings every co-working space and study hall together in one place. Compare prices, internet speed, and power availability, then book your seat directly — no calls, no messages.

features.title: Compare what actually matters
features.lead: Stop guessing. Every space shows real numbers so you can pick the right seat before you leave home.

pricing.title: Transparent pricing
pricing.desc: Hourly and daily prices side by side — no hidden fees and no surprises at the door.

speed.title: Real internet speed
speed.desc: Filter by upload and download so your calls and file uploads hold up where it matters.

power.title: Power status
power.desc: See which spaces have 24/7 or backup power — and book with confidence during outages.

how.title: From browsing to a seat in three steps
how.lead: No calls and no messages. Just open, compare, and book.

explore.title: Explore
explore.desc: Filter Gaza's spaces by price, speed, and power — and see exactly what you get.

book.title: Book
book.desc: Pick a seat and confirm in seconds. Your seat is reserved and the owner is notified instantly.

arrive.title: Show up
arrive.desc: Walk in, plug in, and work. Rate the space so the next member knows what to expect.

roles.title: For everyone — student or space owner
roles.lead: Whether you're looking for a quiet seat or want to list your space, Masahati is built for both sides.

about.title: Masahati was built for Gaza
about.lead: A young Palestinian team that believes co-working is a right for everyone — so it built a platform that brings spaces and people together with trust.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.desc: To make finding a decent workspace easy and trustworthy, whatever the circumstances.

community.title: Our community

values.title: Our values
